notes.title: Announce - Original Soundtrack available !
notes.content:
Hello everyone !
The original soundtrack of Obsolete is now available on the store for sale and as a package with a -10% for 1 week. His presence on the store is there to support us, you can also listen to him on Youtube here in few days.
New things are coming in 1 week, stay tuned ! :)

notes.title: Announce - Major update here !
notes.content:
Hello everyone !

We've been working on an update for 3 weeks that will change a lot of things in the game! We hope you enjoy the new content and have as much fun playing it as we did creating it!
The store page has also been reworked and updated.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38277623/37d355aace6fb766ba145b486efea8af902f6344.png

New additions

-Great improvements to OST overall + news.
-Improvement of some levels.
-Re-work of some textures and new textures
-New noises (SFX), fixed audio issues.
-Added Steam Achievements.
-The menus have been redone
[strike] -New / big improvements to secrets [/strike]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38277623/ab01f55b830c1a3017a7cf8b21edbffb7346a202.png

Technical additions

-menu which summarizes the controls.
-bugfix
-fixed audio issues.
-Controls changed to ZQSD & QWERTY

If you spot any bugs let us know here: Obsoletedev@gmail.com

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38277623/1cbe36cac94b9c69f79206c277dca577deaf2b09.png

Music

Having a lot of tweaks and improvements, Obsolete's OSTs will be available for purchase on steam in about 1 week, (if you want to support us)! They will also be available on Youtube if you want to listen to them for free! (or in the game files) :)

Youtube officiel du Farfelu

Thanks

To all the testers who were great in finding bugs, thanks to those who played (even those who didn't like it :p) and finally thanks to Virgil Marrel for composing such good music and for following me in this project!

A -35% discount is available for 2 weeks! Talk to those around you if you feel like it! ːsteamhappyː

-Farfelu
